findings.title: Content is server-rendered — no JavaScript dependency detected
findings.evidence: Across 3 template type(s), the largest raw-vs-rendered text gap was 0%, below the 15% noise threshold. Crawlers that do not execute JavaScript receive substantially the same content a browser does.

suggested_action.summary: No fix needed. To strengthen further, keep new templates server-rendered and avoid moving existing content behind client-side fetches.

findings.title: Rendered text measured marginally shorter than raw on some pages
findings.evidence: 3 page(s) measured slightly less text after rendering (within 8% tolerance). This is DOM serialization normalising whitespace, not content loss. Deltas are clamped at 0.0 and no gap was reported for these pages.

suggested_action.summary: No action required — measurement artifact, not a site issue.
